sentences.text: Qiliania was an enantiornithean bird, a group of early birds, that lived in what is now Gansu Province in north-western China.
The species name graffini honors Greg Graffin of the band Bad Religion, suggested by co-author Jingmai O'Connor.
The fossils were found in the Xiagou Formation of the Changma Basin.
Qiliania was first named by a team including Shu-An Ji and Peter Dodson in 2011.
Qiliania is classified in the class Aves and the subclass Enantiornithes.
Qiliania lived during the Aptian stage, between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago.
